hookups.source: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880205 (40 public Modern Electric sites list 50-amp, 12 list 30-amp; no site lists water or sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DCNR: 'About 100 tent and trailer sites' in two campgrounds, Lakeside (adjacent to the lake) and Hillside (pet camping). The booking site lists 61 public RV-capable sites (54 Modern Electric, 7 Modern Non-Electric; Hillside 39, Lakeside 22) besides 15 tent-only and 6 walk-to sites, cabins, cottages and yurts. Listed max vehicle lengths run 14-58 ft, mostly 20-40 ft; the non-electric sites take 18-31 ft. All back-in except Lakeside 37 and 39 (parallel).

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park. Added season (early April to mid-October, DCNR), 50-amp electric (no water/sewer at sites), 61 public RV sites to 58 ft, showers/flush toilets/dump/water. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs, pull-throughs; laundry and camp store left unset (the booking page lists a washer & dryer and 'Nearest Camp Store' without saying where). Fees left as recorded (statewide table).
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead, against an --AWH note: stored 'not waterfront' and the note says 'the campground is in a standard wooded loop design set back from the lake. --AWH'. DCNR says 'Lakeside Campground is adjacent to the lake', and ReserveAmerica lists 'Proximity to Waterfront: Waterfront' on 10 Lakeside RV sites (electric 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 30, 33, 33A at 22-43 ft; non-electric 37, 39). AWH may have stayed in Hillside; worth a look at the Lakeside pads, but the --AWH note stands unless AWH says otherwise.
